entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I went to see Shiho today.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: And I told her we settled[n]things with Kamoshida.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: She still hasn't regained[n]consciousness... but I had[n]to go make amends.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Whaddya mean? You didn't[n]do anything wrong, Ann.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But I wasn't there when she[n]needed help. I'm a failure[n]as a friend...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I have to do all I can to make[n]up for that, starting now.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Otherwise I don't think[n]I'll be able to move on.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Man, I didn't know you[n]were so passionate.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I totally didn't notice that[n]back in middle school.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I think it's because of you guys.[n]I'm a little embarrassed though...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Anyway, Ryuji, [fName]...[n]I hope we can keep helping[n]each other out from now on too.
